name: Dolmen Open 2012
information:
The Dolmen Open 2012 is free.
The food will be provided as well as gifts and goodies.
Competitors might be asked to help for cooking when not competing.
The closest train station is "Les Rosiers sur Loire" we will organize cars to pick-up competitors at that train station, or even at "Saumur" if needed. 
Registration will be closed on August, 25th.
Max competitors : 35.
